description: Actual request routing, reply correlation, evidence origin and oracle binding, with an equivalent compute-chunk control.

sabotages.name: keyed updates disappear
sabotages.why: Independent serial replay must reject an incorrect state transition even when both candidates share it.

sabotages.name: keyed lookup mutates state
sabotages.why: Lookups must preserve the state and report the trace-ordered intermediate value.

sabotages.name: keyed cancellation commits an effect
sabotages.why: Forced pre-commit cancellation must leave final state untouched, not merely report Cancelled.

sabotages.name: keyed owner routing collapses to zero
sabotages.why: Private partitions and correlated reply ownership must use the declared key mapping.

sabotages.name: keyed runner bypasses verification
sabotages.why: A controlled service returning cancellation without a stop condition must be rejected by the real runner.

sabotages.name: keyed verifier ignores sequence
sabotages.why: A final-state match cannot substitute for checking the per-key commit sequence.

sabotages.name: equivalent keyed service chunk
sabotages.why: Service chunk size is not an ownership, state or cancellation-effect contract.

sabotages.name: assigned requests all enter worker zero
sabotages.why: Assigned replies must name the requested lane's worker, including nonzero cold lanes.

sabotages.name: terminal replies lose request identity
sabotages.why: The real collector and common verifier must reject duplicate or unknown correlation IDs.

sabotages.name: responses hide pre-admission waiting
sabotages.why: Recorded response origin must be the trace's scheduled arrival, not successful admission.

sabotages.name: runner skips the shared verifier
sabotages.why: A deliberately incorrect service reply must fail through the consumer, not only in direct verifier tests.

sabotages.name: global credit guard is disabled
sabotages.why: Queued, running and completed-but-uncollected requests share one ceiling, not one ceiling per worker.

sabotages.name: equivalent smaller service chunks
sabotages.why: Cancellation-check cadence changes without changing the request result or ownership/credit contract.
